messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx from api-gateway-edge detected. 502/504 rate > 12% over last 2min. auto-page to #incidents and @anna_oncall.

anna_oncall: oncall anna here, joining. seeing a bunch of mobile login failures in Sentry too. exact spike window?

sam_sre: looking at telemetry — spike starts ~ 2026-03-15T15:46Z. edge-proxy region us-east-1 showing upstream timeouts to auth-service and model-router.

mira_prod: customer impact: a subset of API keys getting failures for /v1/chat/completions and /auth/token. payment-related flows look OK.

kevin_net: net team, I'm checking NLB and ALB logs. no obvious connection error spikes at L4, TCP healthy. 502s appear from backend responses.

anna_oncall: actions: 1) reduce traffic to suspect pool, 2) increase gateway replicas, 3) check recent deploys. sam, mira take ownership of debug + mitigations. kevin follow net path.

sam_sre: checking recent deploys — deploy-bot, any deploys to gateway in last 30m?

deploy-bot: deploy: edge-proxy v2.1.9 rolled at 2026-03-15T15:30Z by ci/cd. Canary success 5m, then rolled to 100%.

mira_prod: that coincides. can we rollback to v2.1.8 temporarily?

sk_scratch: (note: reaction :eyes:)

sam_sre: running quick health checks:
```
# curl directly to a gateway pod (example)
curl -sS -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s\n" -o /dev/null http://10.10.5.23:8080/health
# grab recent error lines
kubectl logs deploy/edge-proxy -n gateway --since=10m | rg "502|upstream|timeout" -n | tail -n 40
```

sam_sre: logs show a pattern: "upstream request timed out" and "connection reset by peer" to auth-service pods. latency to auth-service increased from 45ms -> 1.2s recently.

kevin_net: confirmed no scaling event at NLB. Could be auth-service saturation or new TCP keepalive regression in v2.1.9.

anna_oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) divert traffic away from auth-dependent routes for non-critical telemetry, 2) re-enable fallback auth (jwt local verifier) for mobile flows, 3) bump gateway replicas x2. Sam/Kevi run these.

sam_sre: applying scale and route rules now. patching ingress rules to reduce fanout:
```
# sample patch: temporary weight change
kubectl patch virtualservice edge-routing -n gateway --type merge -p '{"spec":{"http":[{"route":[{"destination":{"host":"auth-service","subset":"stable"},"weight":10},{"destination":{"host":"auth-service","subset":"backup"},"weight":90}]}}]}}'
```

sam_sre: scaled edge-proxy from 6 -> 12 pods. rolling restart to pick up config. watching error rate.

mira_prod: creating rollback ticket and pre-approved rollback if error rate doesn't fall under 3% in 5m.

(2m later)

sam_sre: partial improvement: 502/504 down to ~6% but still noisy for specific customer API keys. tailing logs shows auth-service 503s on instance a-3 particularly.

kevin_net: isolating path - traffic to a-3 shows increased tcp resets. routing health shows some host-level CPU spike and long GC cycles.

mira_prod: contacting SRE+Auth oncall to investigate a-3. @auth-team oncall?

anna_oncall: meanwhile, toggle circuit breaker for chat-heavy endpoints so we don't cascade: set max concurrent per connection lower and enable 429 fallback for non-essential requests.

sam_sre: applied circuit-breaker policy to /v1/chat/completions and /v1/embeddings:
```
# envoy config snippet (applied via rollout)
circuit_breakers:
  thresholds:
  - priority: DEFAULT
    max_connections: 200
    max_pending_requests: 100
    max_requests: 1000
```

sam_sre: error rate dipped to 2.1% after circuit breakers + scaling. rolling back changes after full stabilization plan in place.

mira_prod: customer impact summary so far: ~1200 requests failed in spike window (~0.6% of traffic), top impacted customers: acme-inc, chatly, devlabs. Notifying support.

zendesk-bot: created ticket #INC-20260315-142 for high 502/504 spike, auto-attached logs and top-k customer list.

anna_oncall: can we get an RCA temp blurb for customers? Mira draft: root cause likely auth-service overload triggered by edge-proxy behavior in v2.1.9 under certain keepalive patterns. Confirming.

mira_prod: drafting notice: "We experienced elevated 502/504 errors affecting some API routes between 15:30-15:48 UTC due to an upstream auth-service timeout. We mitigated by scaling gateways, adjusting routing to backup auth instances, and enabling circuit breakers. Services are stable. We're investigating root cause and follow up with a detailed postmortem."

kevin_net: follow-up: one auth pod shows oom-kill sequence around spike -> need to check memory regression in v2.1.9 sidecar.

sam_sre: plan: 1) keep routing fallback for 30m, 2) roll edge-proxy back to v2.1.8 in controlled manner if auth team can't confirm fix, 3) capture heap/profile of auth pods.

anna_oncall: agree. Sam, coordinate rollback if rates don't stay <3% in next 10m. Kevin, auth team, get heap/profile. Mira, customer comms ready to send once we confirm stabilization.

(10m later)

sam_sre: stable at <1% for 8m. no rollback required. leaving fallback routing and circuit-breakers in place for now.

mira_prod: customer comms sent to affected accounts + status page updated. support triage handling follow-ups.

anna_oncall: handing off to post-incident doc owners: sam_sre for mitigation timeline, kevin_net + auth-team for root cause, mira_prod for customer comms. Closing incident channel in 30m if no regressions. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident closed (auto) if no alerts for 30m.
